Sin Wen Pao Evening Edition of Nov.28:
NEW SOVIET AMBASSADOR TO CHINA
The U.S.S.R. Government has appointed M. Ivan
Laganetz-Orelsky as the new Soviet Ambassador to China.
The new Ambassador will leave for China
immediately by aeroplane via Siberia. In the meantime,
the affairs of the Embassy will be looked after by
Mr. Melamed, the Charge d'Affaires.
The U.S.S.R. Embassy has already been removed
to Hankow.

《新闻报》晚报，11月28日：
苏联新任驻华大使
苏联政府已任命伊万·拉加涅茨-奥列尔斯基（Ivan Laganetz-Orelsky）先生为苏联新任驻华大使。
新大使将立即乘飞机经西伯利亚前往中国。在此期间，使馆事务将由代办梅拉梅德（Melamed）先生负责。
苏联大使馆已迁至汉口。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No............
Section 1, Special Branch ............ Political
REPORT
Date December 1, 1937
Subject I.M. Luganetz-urelsky ,newly appointed soviet ambassador to
China.
Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by C. Giers

With reference to the endorsement of the D.C. (Special Branch) on the attached translation from the "Sin Wan Pao" of November 28,1937, I have to state that so far no reliable information is available locally regarding the person and antecedents of I.M. LUGANETZ-URELSKY who is reported to have been appointed to succeed Mr. D.V. Bogomolov on the post of the U.S.S.R. Ambassador to China.

Rumours have it that the newly appointed Ambassador is 54 years of age and that he has no previous experience in the capacity of a diplomatic official. Furthermore, it is alleged that his appointment means a firmer attitude of the U.S.S.R. in the Far East.

United Press report dated November 27, Tokyo, to the effect that Luganetz-Vrelsky is in reality Smirnov, former Assistant Commissar of War, is generally treated with scepticism.

It was previously reported in the press that Mr. G.M. Melamed, First Secretary of the U.S.S.R. Embassy at Nanking, is acting as the Soviet Charge d'affaires during the absence of Mr. D.V. Bogomolov who left Nanking for the U.S.S.R. on October 28, 1937 together with Lepin, Soviet military attache.

A. Prokofiev
D.S.I.

D. C. ( Special Branch)

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号............
第一科，特别分支 ............ 政治
报告
日期：1937年12月1日
主题：I.M. 卢加涅茨-乌雷尔斯基（Luganetz-urelsky），新任苏联驻华大使。
制作人：特别调查员普罗科菲耶夫（D.S.I. Prokofiev）。转呈人：C. 基尔斯（C. Giers）

关于特别分支副总监在附上的1937年11月28日《新闻报》译文上的签注，本人须声明，目前本地尚无关于据报被任命接替博戈莫洛夫（D.V. Bogomolov）先生担任苏联驻华大使一职的 I.M. 卢加涅茨-乌雷尔斯基（I.M. LUGANETZ-URELSKY）其人及其背景的可靠情报。

有谣言称，新任大使现年54岁，此前并无担任外交官员的经验。此外，据称其任命意味着苏联在远东采取更强硬的态度。

合众社11月27日发自东京的报道声称，卢加涅茨-弗列尔斯基（Luganetz-Vrelsky）实为前副战争人民委员斯米尔诺夫（Smirnov），该说法普遍受到怀疑。

此前媒体曾报道，苏联驻南京大使馆一等秘书 G.M. 梅拉梅德（G.M. Melamed）先生，在博戈莫洛夫（D.V. Bogomolov）先生缺席期间担任苏联代办；博戈莫洛夫先生已于1937年10月28日与苏联武官莱平（Lepin）一同离开南京前往苏联。

A. 普罗科菲耶夫
特别调查员

特别分支副总监

North China Daily News, November 29,1937

NEW SOVIET ENVOY
TO CHINA
Japanese Reports Claim He Is
War -Commissar

Tokyo, Nov. 27.
Japanese circles here to-day were circulating a report that M. Uganeto Orelsky, new Soviet Ambassador to China, in reality is a former Assistant Commissar of War named Smirnov. The new Ambassador, the report alleged, was proceeding to China with fifty Soviet planes, ten crack Russian aviators and large quantities of munitions.

Meanwhile, it was impossible to disprove rumours that the Soviet Union was planning a diplomatic shake-up in Japan under which the local Embassy staff possibly would be reduced to skeleton proportions.

The Japanese Foreign Office to-day protested to the Soviet Embassy against alleged unfriendly treatment of Japanese consular officials at Vladivostok. The Japanese alleged that Soviet authorities failed to permit

Japanese consular officials from proceeding to their posts promptly and failed to supply an adequate supply of wholesome water to Japanese officials in Russia.

The Foreign Office also alleged that Soviet physicians had refused to attend promptly Japanese residents of the Soviet Union. The local Soviet Embassy was said to have promised to relieve these conditions some time ago, but that the alleged abuses had been permitted to continue.--United Press.

《字林西报》，1937年11月29日

苏联新任驻华使节
日方报道称其为
副战争人民委员

东京，11月27日。
日本各界今日流传一则消息，称苏联新任驻华大使乌加内托·奥列尔斯基（Uganeto Orelsky）先生，实为一名名叫斯米尔诺夫（Smirnov）的前副战争人民委员。据报道，这位新大使正携五十架苏联飞机、十名精锐俄罗斯飞行员及大量军火前往中国。

与此同时，有关苏联计划对日进行外交改组、当地使馆人员可能缩减至最低限度的谣言无法被证伪。

日本外务省今日就所谓在海参崴对日本领事官员的不友好待遇向苏联大使馆提出抗议。日方指控苏联当局未能允许日本领事官员迅速赴任，且未能为在俄日本官员提供充足的清洁饮用水。

外务省还指控苏联医生拒绝及时为在苏日本居民提供医疗服务。据悉，当地苏联大使馆曾在不久前承诺改善这些状况，但所谓的虐待行为仍被放任持续。——合众社。
